Alias.name: Weapon locker switch
Alias.script:
-- Clean up any previous run if swapWeaponTrigger then killTrigger(swapWeaponTrigger) swapWeaponTrigger = nil end if swapEqTrigger then killTrigger(swapEqTrigger) swapEqTrigger = nil end
-- Step 1: fire `eq` and catch the wielded right hand line swapEqTrigger = tempRegexTrigger( "^Wielded in right hand(?:.*): (.+)$", function() killTrigger(swapEqTrigger) swapEqTrigger = nil
local wielded = matches[2]:lower() local putHandle, getHandle, skillCmd, label
if wielded:find("greatsword") then putHandle = "greatsword" getHandle = "blade" skillCmd = "comb" label = "GS -> blade" elseif wielded:find("blade") then putHandle = "blade" getHandle = "greatsword" skillCmd = "2h" label = "blade -> GS" else cecho("\n<red>[swap]</red> Unrecognised weapon in right hand: " .. matches[2] .. "\n") return end
cecho("\n<cyan>[swap]</cyan> Walking to locker room... (" .. label .. ")\n")
-- Step 2: walk there, swap on arrival swapWeaponTrigger = tempTrigger( "Locker room", function() killTrigger(swapWeaponTrigger) swapWeaponTrigger = nil
send("keep " .. putHandle) tempTimer(0.3, function() send("open locker") end) tempTimer(0.6, function() send("put " .. putHandle .. " in locker") end) tempTimer(0.9, function() send("get " .. getHandle .. " from locker") end) tempTimer(1.2, function() send("keep " .. getHandle) end) tempTimer(1.5, function() send(skillCmd) cecho("\n<green>[swap]</green> Done — " .. getHandle .. " equipped, " .. skillCmd .. " applied.\n") end) end )
ice.gotoRoom("locker") end )
send("eq")

Script.name: AoO tracker
Script.script:
-- ===================================================================== -- Attack of Opportunity tracker -- --------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Mirrors the mechanic used by the icesus.core HUD: the server advertises -- an available attack of opportunity through GMCP Char.Status, in the -- fields `momentum` and `special_momentum`. When either is a non-empty -- string, a skill is ready to fire with: use <skillname> -- -- This script keeps a global, aoo, in sync with those fields so the F1 -- key (and anything else) can read them without depending on the full -- icesus.core HUD being installed. If icesus.core *is* loaded it sets the -- exact same GMCP fields, so this works either way. -- =====================================================================
aoo = aoo or {} aoo.momentum = aoo.momentum or "" aoo.specialMomentum = aoo.specialMomentum or ""
-- Pull the current values out of GMCP into our globals. function aoo.update() local s = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status if not s then return end aoo.momentum = s.momentum or "" aoo.specialMomentum = s.special_momentum or "" end
-- True if any attack of opportunity is currently available. function aoo.available() return (aoo.momentum ~= "" and aoo.momentum ~= nil) or (aoo.specialMomentum ~= "" and aoo.specialMomentum ~= nil) end
-- Fire the available skill. Prefers special momentum (usually the rarer / -- stronger proc); falls back to normal momentum. Returns true if it sent. function aoo.use() aoo.update() -- make sure we're current before acting local skill = nil if aoo.specialMomentum and aoo.specialMomentum ~= "" then skill = aoo.specialMomentum elseif aoo.momentum and aoo.momentum ~= "" then skill = aoo.momentum end if skill then send("use " .. skill) cecho("\n<green>[aoo]<reset> used <yellow>" .. skill .. "<reset>.\n") return true else cecho("\n<grey>[aoo]<reset> no attack of opportunity available.\n") return false end end
-- Keep the globals fresh whenever Char.Status arrives over GMCP. registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Status", "aoo.update")
-- Prime once on (re)load in case Status already arrived. aoo.update()
